claim: The executor defines what can happen; R_theta organizes those legal edits into coherent molecular trajectories that achieve nontrivial structural movement without the pathological drift, cycling, or operator collapse induced by unlearned same-support transport laws.
non_claims: no claim about synthetic route plausibility
no claim about medicinal plausibility; the descriptor envelope is a distributional sanity check
no claim that fewer reversals is intrinsically better; reversibility may be part of the reference law
no claim of distribution-learning quality; this is source-conditioned transport, not unconditional generation

r_theta.note: Development checkpoint; predates the code-commit binding, so this workstream is development evidence and not paper-bearing until the frozen seeds exist.

arms.shared_support: identical executable canonical-successor support at every state; only the probability assignment differs

members.law: P_theta(y | x), the frozen learned reference process, conditioned on taking a productive jump
1 / |N+(x)| over distinct productive canonical successors after alias collapse
sum over families k reaching y of qhat(k) / |N_k(x)|, with qhat the frozen realized family law restricted to families legal at x and renormalized there

arms.optional_fourth_arm_not_implemented: empirical family + learned identity; deferred because it needs a within-family score the trajectory row does not carry, and the workstream permits it only if already cheap

rollout.horizon_escalation_rule: H=8 may be compared ONCE on held-in smoke only if H=6 fails to expose structural movement. It is not a tuning knob and never differs across arms.
rollout.common_random_numbers: all arms consume the identical uniform variate at the identical step over the identical sorted successor order
rollout.commit_rule: every accepted canonical successor is committed as sampled; no controller, objective or oracle enters this lane

development.stratification: 4 scaffold-support bands x 3 heavy-atom size bands, 3 sources per cell

confirmatory.stratification: 4 scaffold-support bands x 3 heavy-atom size bands, 8 sources per cell

disjointness.from_exact_target_development_and_sealed: diagnostics/editing_v2_controller_panel_seal.json, both source AND target endpoints of all 91 pairs (164 distinct reserve endpoints)
disjointness.from_retargeting_sources: diagnostics/retarget_calibration_cohort.json is held-in only; verified 0 reserve overlap
disjointness.from_pathwise_constraint_sources: configs/benchmarks/cnof_leads.json is a disjoint benchmark lineage; verified 0 reserve overlap
disjointness.from_global_final_test: diagnostics/editing_v2_final_test_integrity_audit.json records exact_overlap.with_matched_reserve = 0; the reserve and final_test are source-disjoint by construction

confirmatory.authorization_required: the main workstream, in writing, recorded verbatim in the artifact

primary_result.mobility_axis: median over sources of the per-source mean endpoint ECFP4 Tanimoto distance from the source molecule
primary_result.fidelity_axis: mean over sources of the per-source fraction of committed intermediate states inside the held-in descriptor envelope
primary_result.decision_rule: Pareto relation of r_theta to each unlearned arm, using only axes whose paired bootstrap 95% interval over SOURCES excludes zero
primary_result.incomparable_is_a_result: mobility bought with fidelity, or the reverse, is publishable and must not be scalarized away after the fact
primary_result.independent_statistical_unit: the source molecule; rollout seeds are repeated measures and are averaged within source before any interval

stratification: every metric is reported separately across scaffold-support bands 0 / 1-4 / 5-24 / 25+; the goal is an honest characterization of how mobility and fidelity change as training support weakens, not a claim that support does not matter

instrument_gates.falsifiability_gate: every metric in src/compose_v4/experiments/claim2_trajectory_metrics.py METRIC_REGISTRY must declare what value it would take if the hypothesis were false; validate_metric_registry refuses any that does not
instrument_gates.arm_divergence_gate: pairwise total variation between the three laws is recorded at every state; a run whose arms never diverge is INVALID_INSTRUMENT, not a null result
instrument_gates.kernel_cross_check_gate: each source verifies enumerate_successor_row against canonical_successor_result on its source state; any disagreement marks the run INVALID_INSTRUMENT
instrument_gates.power_gate: no Pareto verdict is emitted below 20 sources, whatever the point estimates show

banned_statistics.reference_log_likelihood_of_own_trajecto: E_R[log R] >= E_U[log R] is Gibbs' inequality; the sign is fixed before any data exists
banned_statistics.reference_probability_of_chosen_successo: selector and scorer are the same object
banned_statistics.support_size_by_arm: identical across arms by construction; a difference is a bug, not a result
banned_statistics.validity_rate_by_arm: 100% for every arm is structural, imposed by the executor

stop_rules: all arms nearly identical after the single held-in horizon check -> stop and report that the horizon cannot expose the difference
R_theta collapses to one operator family or cycles pathologically -> stop and report the negative characterization
descriptor metrics reveal broad off-distribution drift -> stop and report
the suite cannot distinguish mobility from trivial growth or shrinkage -> stop; this is why heavy-atom and ring-system change are reported beside Tanimoto distance
kernel cross-check disagreement -> INVALID_INSTRUMENT, fix before any analysis
allowed_calibration: the descriptor envelope, on held-in molecules, before any trajectory exists (done)
the development panel, mechanically and outcome-independently, from held-in sources (done)
one held-in horizon comparison H=6 versus H=8 if and only if H=6 fails to expose movement
forbidden_adaptations: changing the objective, architecture, corpus, operator set or process identity
refitting the descriptor envelope after seeing trajectories
adding, removing or reweighting an arm after seeing results
introducing a scalarization of the two frontier axes after seeing the point estimates
opening the matched reserve without written main-workstream authorization
any use of the global final test

measured_evidence.source: committed diagnostics with >=20 kernel calls per task, so container startup is amortized

cost_model.this_lane_overhead: enumerate_successor_row runs compile_state_successor_map plus forward_compiled_successor_partitions: one mark-execution pass and two model forwards, versus canonical_successor_result's one pass and one forward. Assumed 1.2-1.5x; the smoke MEASURES it and records seconds_per_kernel_call per shard.

confirmatory_matched_reserve_if_authoriz.note: Quoted so the size of the eventual ask is visible now. This lane does not run it and does not select its sources.

smoke_scope.authorized_by: main lane, 2026-08-12, explicitly: 'AUTHORIZE NEXT GATE - the 8-source smoke only'
smoke_scope.rationale: 8 sources is below the pre-declared 20-source floor. If R_theta looks excellent on 8 sources that is not a result, and the analysis script refuses to emit a Pareto verdict regardless of the point estimates.
questions_this_run_is_allowed_to_answer: do all three laws actually diverge on real states
does the alternate learned-law construction numerically agree with the canonical scorer
do trajectories complete under the budget without instrument errors
are reversal, revisit and dead-end measurements behaving as intended
what is the measured runtime and cost per enumeration
smoke_scope.no_automatic_promotion: the 36-source held-in development run is NOT authorized by this smoke passing; it requires a separate main-lane decision after reviewing these gates
smoke_scope.eventual_claim_2_question: does learning organize executable molecular motion into a better mobility-fidelity tradeoff than support-only stochastic rewriting -- NOT 'does R_theta stay close to the training distribution', which a process that barely moves would win trivially

operational_contract.local_entrypoint_must_not_import_rdkit: modal run uses a different interpreter without rdkit; panel selection is a normal python3 script writing a committed artifact under diagnostics/, mounted with add_local_file, and the entrypoint only reads JSON. Enforced by tests/test_claim2_rollout_resumability.py.
durability_layers: server-side drive() fan-out so a client disconnect cannot stall .map()
modal run --detach so the app survives client death
per-source shard commit plus a resumable driver, because neither of the above survived a client-side DNS failure at launch in the main lane
operational_contract.shard_reuse_rule: exact or not at all: source, horizon, seed set, kernel budget, panel_sha256 and family_law_sha256 must all match and budget_exhausted must be false
